title: A Tour of Marsh Lane Wetland Centre
titleCn: 测试夹具：湿地中心导览（多选 + 单选 + 地图）
intro: Part 2. You will hear a guide talking to visitors at a wetland centre.

segments.speaker: guide
segments.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to Marsh Lane. Before we set off, there are a couple of rules.

segments.speaker: guide
segments.text: First of all, please don't feed the birds. Bread makes them ill.

segments.speaker: guide
segments.text: And I'm afraid dogs aren't allowed anywhere on the reserve. Photographs are fine, of course.

segments.speaker: guide
segments.text: One change since last year: the centre now opens an hour earlier, at eight.

segments.speaker: guide
segments.text: The East Lake path is closed at the moment because a pair of rare birds are nesting next to it.

segments.speaker: guide
segments.text: If it's your first visit, follow the one-hour route marked in green.

segments.speaker: guide
segments.text: Now, let's look at the map. We're standing at the visitor centre, at the bottom.

segments.speaker: guide
segments.text: As you go through the gate, the picnic area is immediately on your left.

segments.speaker: guide
segments.text: The willow tunnel is right in the middle of the trees in the woodland.

segments.speaker: guide
segments.text: Keep going north and you'll see the bird hide on the edge of West Lake.

segments.speaker: guide
segments.text: The viewing tower is in the far north-east corner, beyond East Lake.

segments.speaker: guide
segments.text: Finally, the pond-dipping platform is just south of the meadow.

title: A River Fieldwork Project
titleCn: 测试夹具：河流野外项目（三选 + 二选 + 流程图）
intro: Part 3. You will hear two students discussing their fieldwork report.

segments.speaker: anna
segments.text: So, Ben, we need to decide what goes into the report on the river project.

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: Well, the tutor said we must include a map of the sampling sites.

segments.speaker: anna
segments.text: Right, and a table of the water temperatures, of course. Photos are optional.

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: And she wants a short list of references at the end.

segments.speaker: anna
segments.text: What about the problems we had during the fieldwork?

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: The worst thing was the weather. It rained almost every day.

segments.speaker: anna
segments.text: And the equipment kept breaking, especially the pH meter.

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: OK, now let's go over how we processed the samples.

segments.speaker: anna
segments.text: First, the mud was sieved to remove stones.

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: Then we dried it in an oven overnight.

segments.speaker: anna
segments.text: After that, each sample was weighed on the digital scales.

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: Next, we added a few drops of acid to test for lime.

segments.speaker: anna
segments.text: Finally, the results were entered into a spreadsheet.

groups.prompt: Which THREE things must the students include in their report?

options.text: a map of the sampling sites

questions.evidence: include a map of the sampling sites
a table of the water temperatures
questions.explanation: C：table of the water temperatures；B 照片是可选的。
